meta.name: The Watch
meta.description: A group of misfit cops rise up from decades of helplessness to save their corrupt city from catastrophe. Inspired by the characters created by Sir Terry Pratchett’s famous “Discworld” novels.

videos.title: A Near Vimes Experience
videos.overview: Capt. Sam Vimes' life in the City Watch is changed forever when a figure from his past returns to Ankh-Morpork.

videos.title: Ook
videos.overview: The Watch connects Carcer's evil plan to strange goings-on at a magical institution.

videos.title: The What?
videos.overview: The Watch must rob the city's most secretive institution in a desperate effort to find the artifact.

videos.title: Twilight Canyons
videos.overview: Carcer is willing to do anything to find a sword and the Watch is close on his tail.

videos.title: Not on My Watch
videos.overview: The Watch must trek through the Unreal Estate to destroy the sword in a magical lake.

videos.title: The Dark in the Dark
videos.overview: In the race against Carcer for the second mystical artifact, Cheery, Angua and Carrot venture into the Mines of Tak. Cheery must confront the darkness in her past. Vimes and Sybil defend the besieged Watch House from Doctor Cruces and her Assassins.

videos.title: Nowhere in the Multiverse
videos.overview: Sam Vimes wakes up in an alternate universe where he's a prisoner in the middle of a jailbreak.

videos.title: Better to Light a Candle
videos.overview: Carcer's got everything he needs to control the Noble Dragon and destroy Ankh-Morpork.
